**Official Translations:**  
[Indonesian ](https://www.webtoons.com/id/romance/rainy-night/list?title_no=2252)  

“If I love you, it will still be burdensome, right?“


The woman, Yeowon, who couldn't covet anything.  
This man who wants so much, Seo Yu-in.  
Two people who have permeated each other like gently raindrops.  
On a rainy night, the story of a lover begins.


“I, I think you really like it.“  
As In-in faced him inside the umbrella, he blew the rain.  
“Did you know you like me now? Because of the rain?  
"No, it was a long time ago that I liked it..." ... .”  
Considering Yoo In's personality, it was an overly calm confession.  
“I didn’t know I liked it this much.“
